summary.text: Rusty Crowe is a Republican state senator from Johnson City who represents Tennessee Senate District 3 (Carter, Johnson and Washington counties) and is listed as the incumbent candidate in the 2026 election.
He chairs the Senate Health and Welfare Committee and is a U.S. Army veteran.

paragraphs.text: Rusty Crowe was born on April 2, 1947, and has a wife, Sarah, and two children.
He earned a B.S. in criminal justice from East Tennessee State University and a J.D. from Atlanta Law School.
He served in the U.S. Army in Southeast Asia from 1967 to 1971.
Crowe has been a member of the Senate from the 97th through the 114th General Assemblies.
He chairs the Senate Health and Welfare Committee and is a member of the Education and Government Operations committees.
He is a member of American Legion Post 24 and the Lions Club of Johnson City.
